entries.title: Psalms 45:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction; --a song of the Beloved.>> My heart is welling forth [with] a good matter: I say what I have composed touching the king. My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

entries.title: Psalms 45:2
segments: Thou art fairer than the sons of men; grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 45:3
segments: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O mighty one, [in] thy majesty and thy splendour;

entries.title: Psalms 45:4
segments: And [in] thy splendour ride prosperously, because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness: and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

entries.title: Psalms 45:5
segments: Thine arrows are sharp--peoples fall under thee--in the heart of the king's enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 45:6
segments: ¶Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever; a sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom:

entries.title: Psalms 45:7
segments: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy companions.

entries.title: Psalms 45:8
segments: Myrrh and aloes, cassia, are all thy garments; out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

entries.title: Psalms 45:9
segments: Kings' daughters are among thine honourable women; upon thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

entries.title: Psalms 45:10
segments: ¶Hearken, daughter, and see, and incline thine ear; and forget thine own people and thy father's house:

entries.title: Psalms 45:11
segments: And the king will desire thy beauty; for he is thy Lord, and worship thou him.

entries.title: Psalms 45:12
segments: And the daughter of Tyre with a gift, the rich ones among the people, shall court thy favour.

entries.title: Psalms 45:13
segments: All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is of wrought gold:

entries.title: Psalms 45:14
segments: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of embroidery; the virgins behind her, her companions, shall be brought in unto thee:

entries.title: Psalms 45:15
segments: With joy and gladness shall they be brought; they shall enter into the king's palace.

entries.title: Psalms 45:16
segments: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons; princes shalt thou make them in all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 45:17
segments: I will make thy name to be remembered throughout all generations; therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.
